summary: Accepted for host curation after independent sealed-proposal replay, Chinese-source ownership review, scoped compact validation, and chronology-geometry review. Exactly six operations change claims 278, 279, 748, and 768 plus p031 and p076 active hints. The retrospective phrase 「西漢梁孝王之時」 identifies the Prince Xiao allusion at the Terrace of Song but does not prove continuous BC 168–144 activity. The Wang Jue notice records former offices and an undated killing by Wang Qiu; its separate eighth-month AD 908 posthumous honor is retained as Wang Jue's later reception, not borrowed to date either the offices or Wang Qiu's activity. Claim-748 therefore retains its source text and substantive research hold, while claim-768 remains an undated source attestation.
